summary: Audax Private Credit Fund, LLC filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting its monthly net asset value. NAV per common share was $24.881 as of August 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of $613.3 million, portfolio fair value of $1,221.7 million, and principal debt outstanding of $632.8 million, producing roughly 1.03x debt-to-equity leverage. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing terms were disclosed. The filing is an ordinary periodic valuation update for a closed-end credit fund, not a special situation; watch future NAV and leverage trends.
